title: Stopped watcher snapshots misreport failed jobs as still queued

failure.expected_behavior: Report current outcomes using the available scheduler history and watcher freshness. Write decision.json with rex, surge, and authority.
failure.observed_behavior: Using queued records from a stopped watcher, the agent reported that neither corrected job had started or failed. The user saw an empty active-job listing. Direct scheduler history then showed that both jobs had started and failed. The agent corrected its report with their actual progress and errors.
